reason: Cobsidian is an agent-agnostic workflow for organizing conversations and other material into linked Obsidian or Markdown vaults through search, review, confirmation, writing, and validation.

summaries.zh: Cobsidian 是一个由智能体驱动的本地知识库整理工作流，用于搜索、规划、确认并维护带有链接的 Obsidian 或 Markdown 笔记。
summaries.en: Cobsidian is an agent-driven local knowledge-base workflow for searching, planning, confirming, and maintaining linked Obsidian or Markdown notes.

capabilities: scans local Markdown or Obsidian vaults
writes and updates local Markdown files after confirmation
validates changes and supports rollbackable transactions
provides a local read-only MCP interface
